resources.string: Local AC3 conversion of this audio track requires MPV, but this video must stay on Media3. Use PCM or server conversion.
VLC cannot limit multichannel PCM to 5.1 on this output. Stereo is used to respect the channel limit; use Media3 or MPV for 5.1.

Applies to decoded audio (PCM), not to passthrough. Automatic follows the output. 2.0 mixes down to stereo. 5.1 and 7.1 send those channels even when the output reports fewer; if it refuses, playback continues with the reported channels.
AC3 transcoding unavailable: AC3 must be confirmed by the output and enabled in the codec list.
AC3 conversion needs passthrough. Set audio output to Automatic or Force passthrough and the channel mix to Automatic.
Multichannel PCM preserves surround without re-encoding. AC3 transcoding is available with a 2.0 PCM connection.
AC3 transcoding is unavailable with the installed players.
